responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s autoderef/autoref adjustment search used during method lookup, coercions, and overloaded dereference handling. The file computes concrete Adjustment chains for raw dereference, array-to-slice unsizing, and Deref/DerefMut lang-item operator overloads by probing method candidates, resolving the selected impl method, and applying any needed substitutions or self-type unification; it also defines the AutoderefCycle walk that repeatedly tries raw receiver, shared/mut references, unsize, overloaded deref, and indirection until a subclass-specific selection predicate succeeds.
same_name_distinction: Defines the autoderef machinery’s executable behavior: it computes concrete Adjustment sequences, resolves Deref/DerefMut operator-overload methods via method probing and trait lookup, and runs the AutoderefCycle search. Unlike rust-autoderef.h, this file contains the search algorithm and overload-resolution logic rather than just the adjustment data structures and interfaces.
